home.title: ST Innovation | ZeroG
home.metaDescription: ZeroG — patented product display platform. Real products, unique visual experience.
home.whatIsZeroGDesc: ZeroG, (stinovasyon) is a patented product display platform. It's unique in the world. Designed to help advertising agencies, brands, manufacturers, and organizations showcase their products in an extraordinary way for promotional advertising and marketing purposes, providing viewers with a unique and unforgettable visual experience; the products are not digital or holographic, they are real products.
home.tagline: The magic of ZeroG lies not in floating objects in the air, but in drawing people around it intensely.
home.ourReferencesDesc: Please click on the relevant logo to see the promotional video.

about.title: About Us | ST Innovation
about.metaDescription: Learn about ST Innovation's patented technology. Transforming product display and advertising with real floating objects.
about.subtitle: ZeroG innovation leads a new era of product presentation where real, physical objects float in mid-air. Creating unforgettable brand experiences with floating objects.
about.patentP1: Welcome to the future of product presentation. Our core invention, the ZeroG Innovation Product Display Stand, is an unprecedented and patented technology worldwide. This technology enables 3D, tangible, physical objects to elegantly rotate inside boxes of various sizes, completely free from any visible support.
about.patentP2: This is not a hologram, projection, or virtual trick. This is reimagined reality. This invention is set to revolutionize showcase, outdoor, and indoor advertising conventions, offering a powerful solution to the challenge of standing out in a crowded marketplace.
about.visionP1: In a world filled with digital and virtual "innovations," we believe in the power of the physical. Seeing a real product defy gravity creates a profound impact that virtual screens cannot replicate. ST Innovation enables brands to stand out from the crowd and create unique prestige.
about.visionP2: By using our technology, companies can overcome the critical challenge of building a strong brand identity and create a lasting impression that conveys quality, innovation, and admiration.
